speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Do you want some help with that?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, no, no, I got it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, yeah, yeah, he's got it, and that's not surprising. This is something I long ago came to peace with in my role as the beta male.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Open it.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Oh my god, are you okay?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, I'm not. I'm bleeding.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Like a gladiator!

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Oh, honey, you're going to need stitches.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Stitches? With a needle?

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Well, yeah, I mean, just a few.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, okay, yeah, hang on a sec.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: FYI, I was defrosting a steak in there. What a beautiful job Stephanie did. I might have gone with a mattress suture instead of a blanket stitch, but you can't argue with her results. It's a shame it won't scar, the war wound is a time-honoured badge of masculinity.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I can't remember a time when you weren't talking.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Just for the record, my efforts to establish you as the alpha male were not aided by you bursting into tears.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I did not burst into tears, my eyes just got a little watery.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Watery?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: She stuck a needle into my hand!

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Hey, how's my big cry baby?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I didn't cry.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Okay, I'm just teasing you. But, yeah, you did. Alright, it's all good. what do you say we get you home and put you to bed?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, are you still going to spend the night?

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Uh, no, I think that you probably need to rest.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: She's right, as long as you're vomiting, coitus is contra-indicated.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Thank you, Dr. Cooper.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're welcome, Dr. Hofstadter.
